claims: "¡Felices Pascuas!" is a traditional expression in Spanish to wish a happy Pascua de Resurrección.
"¡Felices Pascuas!" is used during Semana Santa and spring to celebrate.
"¡Felices Pascuas!" can also be used to extend good wishes in Navidad.
The main use of "¡Felices Pascuas!" is the celebration of the Christian Pascua.
Other forms of saying "Feliz Pascua" are "¡Feliz Pascua!", "¡Feliz Semana Santa!", and "¡Felices Pascuas de Resurrección!".
